_help: What is in the Sprout Lands UI pack. Read by build_assets.py; see tools/assets/README.md (UI pack).
images: how each sheet is cut into pieces. 'file' is a path in the pack, or a glob ('*.png'): then every matched
file is a piece of its own, named 'prefix' + its file name. 'name' names the sheet (default: the file name).
Cutting: nothing = the whole image is one piece; 'frame': [w, h] = a grid, pieces 'name/07' numbered row by row
(from 'offset': [x, y]; 'columns' and 'rowCount' limit it to a few cells of a big sheet);
'pieces': 'auto' = every separate shape is a piece, numbered in reading order ('gap': n joins shapes closer than
n px, e.g. letters of a word). Pieces are trimmed to their visible pixels.
'names': {"07": "heart"} renames pieces (name/heart). 'split': [left, right, top, bottom] makes nine-patches
(for every piece, or {"piece": [...]} for some): the borders keep their size, the middle stretches.
'rotate': 90 turns the image counter-clockwise (by 90, 180 or 270) before cutting it.
'animation': {'duration': ms, 'playMode': 'LOOP' | 'NORMAL'} with a 'frame' grid: every row is an animation
('name' itself for a one-row sheet, else 'name/row_00'...; or named with 'rows' as in pack.json).
fonts: TTF fonts turned into bitmap fonts at their pixel size ('size' to force one). ASCII only.
ignore: files that are neither (previews, examples, sheets that repeat single files). Only what the game's UiImage
and UiFont enums list is packed; build/assets-preview/index.html shows everything with its name.
